mechanism_narrative: FGFR1 (RTK) and OSMR (type I cytokine receptor) are co-expressed in aged muscle FB and EnFB. The flexible_GS8 linker (~40 Å) forces FGFR1's kinase domain to transphosphorylate OSMR's intracellular tyrosines, creating docking sites for GRB2/SHC1 (→MAPK), FRS2/GAB1/PIK3R1 (→PI3K-AKT), and STAT3/JAK1 (→JAK-STAT). PLCG1 is sterically excluded by the asymmetric ECD geometry (355 vs 713 aa), suppressing Ca²⁺/NFAT signaling. The biased output shifts aged FB/EnFB toward a young-like transcriptional program: upregulating contractile/structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, TAGLN) and downregulating aged IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN) and inflammatory markers (IL32, TXNIP).
